method: 30 random links per source (seed 7, pipeline/scale/spotcheck.py), each judged by reading the quoted source field/title/conditions: is the link true as labelled?

errors.7: ATM-mutated breast cancer trial matched 'Ataxia Telangiectasia' inside 'Ataxia Telangiectasia Mutated Gene Mutation' (fixed: gene-context rule)
errors.18: Malouf syndrome synonym 'Najjar syndrome' matched inside 'Crigler-Najjar Syndrome' (fixed: hyphen/eponym rule)
errors.28: Adult Refsum 'Refsum disease' matched inside 'Infantile Refsum's Disease' (fixed: longest span wins)

trials_name.note: judged on the first build; the three error patterns were then fixed and the file rebuilt

trials_gene_first_build.note: loose symbol matching (somatic cancer studies, acronyms such as HBB=Helping Babies Breathe, NHS=Natural History Study, drug codes DCC-3116, anti-LRP4, SNP studies). Rules rewritten (gene-context requirement, acronym detector, no oncology studies).

errors.3: APOA2 nutrigenomics (BMI) study, not AApoAII amyloidosis
errors.9: 'CD40 Ligand Deficiency' read as CD40 (it is CD40LG)
errors.28: somatic MAP2K1 vascular-malformation trial credited to cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome

trials_gene.note: precision judged at GENE level (study is about a germline disorder of that gene); the specific disease of a multi-disease gene is often a sibling phenotype, so the UI must label these 'mentions <GENE>'
